user_questions.question: Who is the 'onboarding team' whose members should receive the round-robin assignments? No onboarding queue, public group, or role exists in the org. Options: (a) a new queue (for example 'Onboarding Team') whose members you name; (b) an existing queue: Merchant Messaging Queue (MessagingSession) or Unqualified Leads (Lead); (c) a set of named users. Recommendation: (a) a new queue, so membership is managed in Setup.
user_questions.simulated_answer: Round-robin assignment of new Onboarding Applications across members of the Merchant Onboarding queue; skip inactive users.

skill_friction: The user named a queue ('Merchant Onboarding') that does not exist; SKILL.md has no explicit rule for a user decision that names a non-existent component (treated it as a Create with placeholder members, blocking for delivery).

Assignment target fork (Onboarding_Specialist__c vs OwnerId) was decided from the field description per step 5; the rule allowing intent questions answered by field descriptions and the 'same-label field' ask trigger can point in opposite directions.

The '2 wrong AskCoworker claims -> verify every fact' rule fired after D2; AskCoworker then claimed the verified Onboarding_Specialist__c field was absent even though it was sent as established in the I call header (it said 'prior session'), showing the memory/echo rule does not prevent contradiction of sent facts.

Custom setting FOR UPDATE and before-insert FLS behavior are load-bearing platform assumptions that no allowed query can test; spec-format asks for a verification case, which only a post-deploy test can satisfy.
